Key AttributeDexterity / Charisma
Hit Died8
HP beyond 10th+2 HP a level, plus your Constitution modifier
Complexity★★☆☆☆ Easy
WeaponsRapier, longsword, short sword, dagger, main gauche, hand crossbow, knife, sling
ArmourLight armour. No shield.
BtH+2 per 3 levels (+8 at 12th, +16 at 24th)
IdentityA flamboyant duellist who wins on footwork, flair and nerve, turning aside blows and answering each one with a riposte.

Level by Level at a Glance

What you gain and when. Full details are under Class Abilities.

LvlYou gain
1Finesse, Agile Defence, Opening Flourish, Flourish Manoeuvres (Parry, Riposte)
2Duel's Rhythm
4Balestra
5Dazzling Combo (Extra Attack)
6Relentless Assault
7En Garde, Disarming Strike, Agile Defence +2
8Flèche
9Flourish option: Acrobatic Escape, kit improves
10Master Duelist
13Perfect Parry, Agile Defence +3
15+1 Dexterity
17Second Flourish, Flèche improves
19Agile Defence +4
20Renown: Salle
24The Last Word, Master Duelist improves

Class Abilities

1st Level

Finesse

  • Effect: You may use your Dexterity modifier instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls with any Light melee weapon (rapier, dagger, main gauche, short sword).

Agile Defence

  • Effect: +1 AC while wearing light armour or no armour and carrying no shield. Does not stack with other unarmoured bonuses of the same kind.
  • An additional +1 at 7th, 13th, and 19th levels

Opening Flourish

  • Effect: Your first hit in each encounter adds your Charisma modifier to damage.

Flourish Manoeuvres

  • Effect: Your out-of-turn tricks, Parry, Riposte, and later additions, all draw from the same well.
  • Once per round, out of turn, perform one Flourish Manoeuvre from those currently known.
  • Using one manoeuvre in a round means none of the others are available until the next round.
  • You can't use them while wearing medium or heavy armour or while carrying a shield.
  • Known at 1st level: Parry and Riposte.
  • Parry: when struck in melee, make a Dexterity check (d20 + Dexterity modifier) against the attacker's attack roll. If it meets or beats the roll, negate the hit entirely.
  • Riposte: when an enemy misses you with a melee attack, make one melee attack against it if it is within your reach. This is your Flourish Manoeuvre; it is not an extra attack.

2nd Level

Duel's Rhythm

  • Effect: While exactly one enemy is within your reach, after each attack you make against it you may move 10ft, on top of your speed, without provoking Attacks of Opportunity from it, and you have Advantage on saves against its spells and abilities.

4th Level

Balestra

  • Effect: On a turn you make an attack, your speed increases by 10ft (20ft from 13th level), and no creature you attacked this turn can make an Attack of Opportunity against you this turn.

5th Level

Dazzling Combo

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage while Duel's Rhythm is on (only one enemy in your reach).
  • If both attacks hit, Encore: the second hit adds your Charisma modifier to damage again, as Opening Flourish does.
  • Opening Flourish, Encore and Relentless Assault add together on the same hit. Disarming Strike and Master Duelist are riders: one of them on any one hit.

6th Level

Relentless Assault

  • Effect: Once per round, when you hit a creature you have already hit since the start of your turn, add 1d4 damage.

7th Level

Disarming Strike

  • Effect: Once per round, when you hit, the target also makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or drops what it holds, and you may knock it 10ft away.

En Garde

  • Effect: Advantage on all initiative rolls.

8th Level

Flèche

  • Effect: As part of your action on your turn, lunge for a second strike: make one additional melee attack this round, once per encounter (twice per encounter from 17th level, once per round). This is an extra attack, rolled with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

9th Level

  • Flourish Manoeuvres gains a new option, Acrobatic Escape: when an attack hits you, halve its damage and move up to 10ft without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.

10th Level

Master Duelist

  • Effect: Once per day, when you hit, the target makes a Will save against your Class Save DC or is Frightened of you for the encounter, and every creature of lower Level than you that sees it has Disadvantage on its first attack against you.
  • 24th level: once per encounter instead of once per day

13th Level

Perfect Parry

  • Effect: A Parry that succeeds on a natural 16 or higher is a Perfect Parry: it succeeds whatever the attack roll was, and you also Riposte, at no cost.

15th Level

  • Dexterity Bonus: permanent +1 Dexterity. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).

17th Level

Second Flourish

  • Effect: You may perform two Flourish Manoeuvres each round instead of one, both out of turn.

20th Level

Renown: Salle

  • Effect: You may found a salle, a fencing school (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d6 students and one 1st-level Swashbuckler join it. While you hold it, you have Advantage on Reaction Checks with duellists and nobles.

24th Level

The Last Word

  • Effect: Once per encounter, when an attack hits you, turn it aside: it misses. This needs no check and uses no Flourish Manoeuvre. If it was a melee attack and you have a Flourish Manoeuvre left this round, you may Riposte it.

Kits: Duelling Schools of Arneyan

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Swashbuckler folder. Drag one onto your character.

Swashbuckler Kits represent the fencing school or street tradition that shaped the character's blade. The peoples, orders and places a kit names are examples, not the only ones: a kit suits anyone from a tradition like it.
